abstract.summary: MOTHERSHIP OS is a business operating system built for small business owners where AI accountability is anchored to a clinical mission substrate. It ensures that both the Human owner and Specialist Instances (AI) are symmetrically bound to the mission goals of the firm. By utilizing the BABBLE Framework, it turns everyday business actions into machine-usable evidence that survives audits, bank reviews, and legal challenges.

core_claims.title: Claim 01: Mission Goals First
core_claims.description: All operations begin with the declared objectives of the firm; the mission provides the absolute boundary for both Human and AI actions.

core_claims.title: Claim 02: People First, AI Second
core_claims.description: Governance is defined by relational bonds and mutual obligations toward the mission rather than opaque model moralities.

core_claims.title: Claim 03: The Universal Safety Shell
core_claims.description: A three-layer jurisdiction-agnostic perimeter: (1) Local Legal/Regulatory, (2) ISO Management Systems, and (3) Financial Reporting Standards.

core_claims.title: Claim 04: Sovereign Over-Engineering
core_claims.description: The system follows the cascading over-engineering pattern established by nations: National Base Standards → Sector Specific Overlays → Tenant Technical Standards.

governance_shell.description: The Labyrinth Governance Shell is a three-slot architecture that remains constant regardless of jurisdiction.

slots.name: Local Legal Perimeter
slots.description: National regulator and statutory law (e.g., BNM, MAS, NAIC/State DOIs) and local data-protection rules.

slots.name: ISO Management Systems
slots.description: International standards for Quality (ISO 9001), Safety (ISO 45001), and Information Security (ISO 27001/27701).
slots.enforcement: Audit-ready process maps and risk guardrails.

slots.name: Financial Reporting & Disclosure
slots.description: Mandatory financial statement compliance via IFRS or local GAAP (e.g., US GAAP).

sentinel_protocol.description: The Sentinel Protocol is the technical law engine governing authorization and routing within the corporate sovereign.

constraint_sets.name: Mission Guardrails
constraint_sets.description: Computed constraints that define permissible behavior and scope based on mission intent.

agent_contracts.name: Job Descriptions
agent_contracts.description: Contracts that bind specific roles to finite mission scopes and APIs.

external_constraint_enforcement.description: Sentinel eliminates the opacity of vendor-unilateralism.
principles: Governance structure lives outside any single model substrate.
Constraints are only amendable via formal KONTROL changes.
14ms time/place latching for every agent action.

perception_engine.name: THE BABBLE FRAMEWORK
perception_engine.description: A three-rail architecture designed to repair the conversion layer between physical reality and machine-usable evidence.

rails.name: Vision Rail

rails.name: Audio Rail
rails.description: Preserves room tone and tonal truth as distinct evidentiary layers for forensics.

rails.name: Machine Rail
rails.description: Ingests telematics and IoT signals as first-class anchored observations.

anchors.space: GNSS, RSSI, and WiFi spatial context.
anchors.identity: Asymmetric signatures via Google Cloud KMS under tenant-scoped control.

sovereign_bond_stack.description: Defines the symmetric flow of authority and liability in service of the mission.

foundational_bonds.name: Founder ↔ Organization
foundational_bonds.label: Primary Authority Latch
foundational_bonds.description: The Founder retains the Burden of Intent; the Organization carries the Burden of Context.

foundational_bonds.name: All ↔ Source of Truth
foundational_bonds.label: Forensic Anchor
foundational_bonds.description: A company is a separate legal person under national law; the founder and officers are natural persons who carry personal legal duties for how that legal person is directed and used.

cstride_drift.name: Drift Detection
cstride_drift.description: Forecasting operational anomalies using the ISO 31000 risk management framework.

vault.description: Authoritative knowledgebase substrate for proven patterns; shared forensic memory.
